field_guide.cik: Company identifier stored as text. Join filings using both CIK and accession number.

field_guide.fact_category: Taxonomy namespace. Compare concepts only under compatible definitions.
field_guide.fact_value: Value in the returned unit. NULL is missing and never implies zero.
field_guide.unit: Original units. USD values are unscaled dollars.
field_guide.end_date: Fact period end. It can precede the filing's fiscal year.
field_guide.fiscal_year: Fiscal-year label of the disclosure. Verify the fact's actual end_date.
field_guide.fiscal_period: Source fiscal-period label. Check period length and frame for flows.
field_guide.frame: Supplementary period indicator. A missing frame does not establish annual duration.
field_guide.filed_date: Submission date, distinct from the fact period end.
field_guide.form_type: Source filing form. One period may be disclosed in several filings.
field_guide.accession_number: SEC submission identifier. A matching filings row may be absent.
field_guide.dimension_segment: Segment scope if supplied. Absence alone does not prove comparability.
field_guide.dimension_geography: Geographic scope if supplied. Absence alone does not prove comparability.

hits.text: Number of customers with ACV greater than $1 million. We count the total number of customers with annual contract value (“ACV”) greater than $1 million as of the end of the period. We had 2,109, 1,885, and 1,626 customers with ACV greater than $1 million as of December 31, 2024, 2023 and 2022, respectively. For purposes of customer count, a customer is defined as an entity that has a unique Dunn & Bradstreet Global Ultimate (“GULT”) Data Universal Numbering System (“DUNS”) number and an active subscription contract as of the measurement date. The DUNS number is a global standard for business identification and tracking. We make exceptions for holding companies, government entities and other organizations for which the GULT, in our judgment, does not accurately represent the ServiceNow customer. For example, while all U.S. government agencies roll up to “Government of the United States” under the GULT, we count each government agency that we contract with as a separate customer. Our customer count is subject to adjustments for acquisitions, spin-offs and other market activity; accordingly, we restate previously disclosed number of customers with ACV greater than $1 million calculations to allow for comparability. hits.text: Renewal rate. We calculate our renewal rate by subtracting our attrition rate from 100%. Our attrition rate for a period is equal to the ACV from customers lost during the period, divided by the sum of (i) the total ACV from all customers that renewed during the period, excluding changes in price or users, and (ii) the total ACV from all customers lost during the period. message.content:
**ServiceNow, Inc. (CIK 1373715) — AI / Now Assist positioning and recent trend**

**Positioning (from the FY2024 Form 10-K, report period ended 2024-12-31, accession 0001373715-25-000010, file `data/filings/1373715/now-20241231.htm`)**

- **Strategic framing:** ServiceNow describes AI — "particularly Generative AI ('GenAI') and agentic AI" — as "driving a new wave of technology transformation," and calls itself "an early leader in applying AI to enterprise workflows," working "to remain at the forefront of AI" (chunk `1373715/now-20241231:9187`).
- **Product architecture:** Now Assist is the company's AI solution, **embedded in the Now Platform** and "available for certain products at an additional cost" — i.e., a monetized upsell layer rather than a free feature. It is positioned as "an AI platform for business transformation" that accelerates customers' ROI on the Now Platform (same chunk).
- **Breadth of portfolio:** Now Assist is offered as workflow-specific modules — CSM (`:23912`), ITOM (`:18878`), Security Operations (`:21351`), SPM (`:22050`), FSM (`:24933`), LSD (`:30636`), Creator (`:32925`), Source-to-Pay (`:35233`) — plus industry solutions (Financial Services, Manufacturing, Technology) (`:26254`, `:27132`).
- **Agentic AI:** Described as "the next evolution of GenAI," available to customers as a Now Assist feature for building tailored agentic skills (`:10556`).
- **Differentiation claims:** Customer choice of ServiceNow LLMs, third-party LLMs, or their own; built-in AI governance (monitoring, guardrails, benchmarking, usage analytics); a single data model and integrated data layer (`:14517`). Partner ecosystem expansion, e.g., co-developing native AI agents with NVIDIA Agent Blueprints (`:40716`).
- **Roadmap intent:** "Since launching AI-powered versions of our products, we have continued to expand the Now Assist product portfolio and plan to continue to embed AI capabilities in our portfolio in the future" (`:11962`) — this is a stated plan, not a realized result.

**Recent trend (disclosed financials, FY2022–FY2024)**

| Metric | FY2022 | FY2023 | FY2024 | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue (USD) | 7,245,000,000 | 8,971,000,000 | 10,984,000,000 | facts 1349396, 1349408, 1349417 |
| Remaining performance obligations (USD) | 14,000,000,000 | 18,000,000,000 | 22,300,000,000 | facts 1349440, 1349444, 1349448 |
| Customers with ACV > $1M | 1,626 | 1,885 | 2,109 | 10-K text, chunk `:155333` |

- Revenue growth: **+22.4% in FY2024** (derived: 10,984/8,971 − 1), versus +23.8% in FY2023 (8,971/7,245 − 1). Growth remains strong but decelerated slightly.
- RPO growth: **+23.9% in FY2024** (22,300/18,000 − 1), indicating contracted backlog continues to expand at a similar pace.
- Large-customer count grew **+11.9%** in FY2024 (2,109 vs. 1,885), continuing the expansion trend.

**Limitations and caveats**

- The bundled 10-K does **not** disclose a standalone Now Assist revenue, ACV, attach rate, or customer count. The AI contribution to the reported trend is therefore **not separately quantified** in the available evidence; the revenue/RPO/customer figures are total-company metrics, and attributing them to AI would be inference, not disclosure.
- The company does state qualitatively that "we expect AI to be an increasingly important driver of future growth, although, like many innovations, it presents risks and uncertainties" (`:70554`) — a forward-looking expectation, not a historical result.
- **Risk disclosures** (hypothetical, not realized events): AI technology "is rapidly evolving and to remain competitive, we will need to make significant investments"; competitors "may develop or incorporate AI into their products more quickly or successfully than us," and "we may not be able to compete effectively in the evolving AI market" (`:70887`). Also flagged: EU AI Act compliance costs (`:71670`), IP/copyright and reputational risk from AI use (`:72294`), and competition from cloud vendors building AI-powered automation (`:64540`).
- Only one local report (FY2024 10-K) is bundled, so no earlier-year narrative comparison of Now Assist positioning was possible; the trend above is built from XBRL facts spanning FY2022–FY2024.
